payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the NLG tasks considered in the study, including the focus on end-to-end data-driven NLG and the comparison of different approaches and metrics.

claims.text: The paper focuses on end-to-end data-driven NLG methods, comparing three different approaches.
The study evaluates 21 automated metrics across different domains and datasets.
The systems can produce ungrammatical output by generating word-by-word and learning from noisy data.
The paper includes a detailed error analysis indicating metrics' reliability issues at the sentence-level.
